text:
Priya N: paging Sre + billing — noticed customers reporting doubled token counts in invoice preview after last night's aggregation run. not all accounts, looks like ones reprocessed during the migration window. @billing-team @sre please triage. creating thread to coordinate.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • INC-2026-0457 • Severity: P2 • Pager notified: @oncall-sre @billing-oncall
Elliot R: seeing the same in metrics. sample account: acct_9d3f shows 2x lines for 'generation' for 2026-03-12 00:00-08:00. stack trace points to re-run of aggregator job "usage-agg-v2" that retried partial shards.
Dan L: quick ask — can we flip the aggregation fallback to the previous stable aggregator (agg-v1) while we root cause? doing that would stop double counting on newly requested previews.
Priya N: good idea. oncall can do that? I'm ~15m out, so starting the handoff. Dan — you take next 2 hours. cc @Joanne_M for comms.
Dan L: taking it. will toggle feature flag now and watch telemetery.
deploy-bot: feature-flag toggle requested by Dan L: FLAG usage_aggregator=agg-v1 -> IN_PROGRESS
Dan L: toggled to agg-v1. rolling back hot switch across regions. monitoring token ingestion and invoice-preview API.
Elliot R: running a quick reconciliation query to find affected accounts — will paste results in a sec.
Elliot R: ```sql
-- find accounts where previews show more tokens than ledger
select account_id, preview_tokens, ledger_tokens, preview_ts
from invoice_preview
join ledger_consumption using (account_id, window_start)
where preview_tokens > ledger_tokens * 1.1
order by preview_tokens - ledger_tokens desc
limit 200;
```
Elliot R: initial run shows ~142 accounts with >10% discrepancy, mostly created or reprocessed between 2026-03-12T02:00 and 2026-03-12T06:30 UTC.
Sam K: finance here — do we expect customer-facing invoices already sent? need list asap so we can prepare reconciliation notes and potential credits.
Dan L: invoices were not auto-emailed for that window — we gate emailing on final ledger commit. previews only. however some customers may have pulled previews manually. we should still notify.
Joanne M: drafting status page + customer notification. suggested short status page blurb:

"We are investigating an issue where some customers may see duplicated or inflated usage in the invoice preview. This may affect previewed token counts for a subset of accounts during a limited window on 2026-03-12. Final invoices are not impacted. We're reverting to a stable aggregator and investigating root cause. Updates will follow here and via support." 

Comments? I'll post in <https://status.redwood.ai|status.redwood.ai> once approved.
Priya N: wording looks good. add "If you saw unexpected preview charges, reach out to billing@redwood.ai and include your account id."
Joanne M: updated.
support-bot: recommended canned reply for CS:

"Thanks for the report — we are aware of an issue causing inflated usage counts in the invoice preview for some accounts during 2026-03-12. Final invoices were not generated with these inflated values. We've reverted the preview aggregator and are investigating. If you'd like, we can review your preview and confirm whether your final invoice will be affected."

Use tag: BILLING-PREVIEW-2026-03-12
Dan L: monitoring metrics — preview ingestion dropped to baseline within 3 minutes of the flag flip. no new duplicate entries observed.
Elliot R: started backfill scan to identify all affected previews. exporting CSV to /mnt/tmp/billing-dup-2026-03-12.csv and notifying finance.
Sam K: got the CSV. we'll cross-check against customers who received manual previews or had export pulls. prepping reconciliation note: internal memo template:

- Incident ID: INC-2026-0457
- Impact: inflated invoice preview token counts for ~142 accounts (preview only)
- Customer impact: previews may show inflated counts; no final invoices generated with these counts; some customers could have manually downloaded previews.
- Mitigation: reverted to agg-v1, stopped reprocessing window, started scan to identify affected previews.
- Next steps: reconcile previews -> regenerate and/or issue credits if final invoice was impacted.

Sam K: will assemble numbers and draft finance communication by EOD.
Dan L: note — root cause likely regression in window dedupe logic in agg-v2 when shard replays occur. pushing a patch to agg-v2 dedupe logic but won't deploy until we validate in staging.
Priya N: handing off primary incident ownership to Dan L for next 2 hours. I'll be back on in the afternoon for postmortem.
Dan L: acknowledged. will keep this thread updated. next update in 30m or sooner if anything changes. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED • INC-2026-0457 • Owner: Dan L • Severity: P2 • Status: mitigation in progress
Priya N: quick note for postmortem — please capture: aggregator fallback decision timeline, list of affected accounts, timing of feature-flag toggle, planned QA for agg-v2 fix.
Joanne M: posted status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/inc-2026-0457 — public update sent. will prepare customer email draft for support to use.
support-bot: customer email draft ready under /docs/billing/incident-templates/BILLING-PREVIEW-2026-03-12.md
Dan L: continuing monitoring. if anyone sees a customer reporting incorrectly charged final invoices, escalate to Sam and tag this thread.
Elliot R: scan complete; attaching sample of top 20 affected accounts in thread (sent to finance & support). will include hashes not raw ids for privacy.
Sam K: thanks — finance will prioritize any accounts that requested preview exports. we'll prepare credit ledger entries if needed.
Joanne M: prepping final communication to affected customers once we have reconciliation list. aiming for initial outreach within 6 hours.
Priya N: thanks team. leaving the channel but I'll check in later. Good handoff.
